test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

INDIA : FKAFX :: ESTONIA : BPQLKFX :: MALAYSIA : ?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:** Each letter of the given word is decreased by 3.**

For, INDIA : FKAFX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/901b3e048093b4b60e0af7151f9e04e99d542a3a6c3164515f4283fca551ccc8.png] 

For, ESTONIA : BPQLKFX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b605f419a15804482f885c21bc834295a7b327e76320cdbd215cea5f9ce3e974.png] 

Similarly, MALAYSIA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef7c00d90a9a31a67a757fe0484a63c53ea2ed5558a336492975b9e45daf2a7.png] 

So,** MALAYSIA** will be written as** JXIXVPFX.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***
